Question: \(ABCD\) is a square of side length \(\sqrt{3} + 1.\) Point \(P\) is on \(\overline{AC}\) such that \(AP = \sqrt{2}.\) The square region bounded by \(ABCD\) is rotated \(90^\circ\) counterclockwise with center \(P,\) sweeping out a region whose area is \(\dfrac{1}{c}(a\pi + b),\) where \(a,\) \(b,\) and \(c\) are positive integers and \(\gcd(a, b, c) = 1.\) What is \(a + b + c?\)
